clue.text: Spot cash the bookies must be prepared to pay out

definitions.text: the bookies must be prepared to pay out

parts.note: a spot is a place or location
cash is money

explanation.surface: A punter demands ready cash that the bookmakers have to have on hand.
explanation.walkthrough: In horse-race betting, a 'place' bet pays if the horse finishes in the first few; the payout on it is what the bookmakers owe.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the sum paid on each-way or place bets when a horse finishes second or third, a liability bookmakers must cover.

clue.text: Heavenly sign I left turned on

indicators.note: turned means the two letters before it are read backwards

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: An astrologer turned on by a star sign.
explanation.definitionFit: Leo, whose symbol is the beast, is one of the twelve zodiac constellations, a sign in the heavens.

clue.text: Cryptic communication receives from the tax inspector

explanation.surface: Someone gets a puzzling message from the taxman.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain the tax office sends each employee a 'notice of coding' fixing their tax allowance, the thing received from the inspector.
explanation.definitionFit: Putting a message into a secret cipher makes it cryptic; the British tax office also issues a notice setting an employee's tax code.

clue.text: Set off on horseback?

explanation.surface: A rider departs with a question mark over the journey.
explanation.definitionFit: A jewel set in a frame to show it off is placed in a setting; a rider astride a horse is in the saddle.

clue.text: Writers crushingly dealt with by cocoa manufacturers

definitions.text: crushingly dealt with by cocoa manufacturers

explanation.surface: Authors are savaged by chocolate makers.
explanation.definitionFit: Pen points are the writing tips of fountain pens; roasted cocoa-bean fragments are crushed into chocolate liquor at the factory.

clue.text: Detectives who assemble at railway depots?

explanation.surface: Police officers gather at the goods sidings.
explanation.walkthrough: Scotland Yard is London's police headquarters, so its detectives are Yard men; railway workers in marshalling yards are the same word.
explanation.definitionFit: Scotland Yard officers are called by the name of their headquarters; railway employees who make up trains in sidings share it.

clue.text: Took the chief role in a Disney film about a bumble bee

indicators.note: in tells us one piece sits inside the other here

parts.note: Dumbo is the 1941 Disney film about a flying elephant
to lead is to take the chief role, past tense led
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A star played the lead in an animated film about an insect.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an old English dialect name for the large hairy humming insect, later borrowed by J. K. Rowling for a wizard.

clue.text: A sign of passionate involvement

parts.note: an ornamental knot, tied as a token of romantic attachment, is read as the involvement, a tangle, of those in love

explanation.surface: Evidence of a passionate affair.
explanation.definitionFit: A decorative intertwined knot was traditionally a token exchanged between sweethearts.

clue.text: Chancy game play with Latin scholars

explanation.surface: A gamble of a pastime played among classicists.
explanation.walkthrough: In Latin ludo means 'I play', so a Latin scholar would read the board game's name as that verb.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a dice-and-counters board game, and the Latin verb for 'I play'.

clue.text: Considerably more than one song of undoubted quality?

explanation.surface: A singer has plenty of hits of real merit.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means quite a lot of people or things; a 'number' is also a song, so a fine song is a quality piece.

clue.text: 2 to I for example

parts.note: the figure 2 set against one is twice as much, read like betting odds

explanation.surface: A betting odds price, two to one, offered as a sample.
explanation.definitionFit: Two is twice one, so the relation of 2 to 1 is a twofold multiple.

clue.text: What the athlete assumed in addressing letters?

indicators.note: in tells us the answer lies tucked inside the run of the words that follow

explanation.surface: Which name did the sportsman adopt when writing to his fans?
explanation.walkthrough: 'assumed' means put on, as of a garment, not adopted as a name; 'in' points to the letters running across the join of 'addressing letters'.
explanation.definitionFit: A sleeveless running vest is the garment an athlete puts on before a race.

clue.text: Steps taken by individuals to guard the establishment?

definitions.text: Steps taken by individuals to guard the establishment?

parts.words: Steps taken by individuals to guard the establishment?
parts.note: reads like political measures to protect the ruling class, but the steps are the marching paces of a guard on watch outside a building

explanation.surface: Measures taken by private citizens to defend the ruling order.
explanation.definitionFit: A soldier posted on watch paces up and down outside a building as an assigned task.

clue.text: The plain facts about the nudist colony?

explanation.surface: A report gives the unvarnished account of a naturist camp.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means the unembellished facts; read literally it describes the unclothed reality of a naturist camp.

clue.text: It sharply picks up the cards left after the deal

definitions.text: the cards left after the deal

explanation.surface: Someone sharp collects the leftover cards after dealing.
explanation.definitionFit: A bird of prey's claw grips its prey; in card games the stock of undealt cards also has this name.

clue.text: Make amends, as bathers will eventually

explanation.surface: Swimmers will at last put things right.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as re-dress, it is what bathers do when they put their clothes back on.
explanation.definitionFit: To put right a wrong is to compensate for it; swimmers clothe themselves again after the swim.

clue.text: Registers for a continental breakfast?

explanation.surface: Records kept for the morning meal abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: Official lists of names are registers; bread buns, with coffee, make up the European breakfast.

clue.text: The Philistine god an Israelite tribe turned on

indicators.note: turned means the tribe's name is read backwards

parts.note: Gad was one of the twelve tribes of Israel
taken as written

explanation.surface: Biblical tribes turn on the deity of their enemies.
explanation.definitionFit: The Old Testament names this fish-bodied deity as the one worshipped by the Philistines, whose temple Samson pulled down.

clue.text: Victor's fabulous Greek patroness

parts.note: the winged goddess of victory in Greek myth, read as the mythical sponsor of anyone who wins

explanation.surface: A champion's legendary Greek benefactress.
explanation.definitionFit: She is the winged goddess of victory in Greek mythology, so the protector of every winner.

clue.text: See to an advance of money

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning see or behold

explanation.surface: Arrange for some money to be handed over in advance.
explanation.definitionFit: A sum lent is an advance of money to be repaid later.

clue.text: River in upland country renounced by the hermit?

indicators.note: in tells us the river letter goes inside the upland word

parts.note: a wold is open upland country, as in the Cotswolds

explanation.surface: A recluse gives up a stream in the hill country.
explanation.walkthrough: A wold is a stretch of open rolling upland in England; the definition works because a hermit withdraws from society.
explanation.definitionFit: A recluse gives up society and earthly affairs, the secular realm of everyday life.

clue.text: Wide diversity about a Japanese Buddhist of shrivelled and dried-up appearance

indicators.note: about tells us the scrambled letters surround the Buddhist
diversity suggests the letters of the word before it are varied into a new order

parts.note: Zen is a school of Buddhism from Japan

explanation.surface: A broad range of opinions surrounds a gaunt Japanese monk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wide' looks like an adjective but is the fodder for 'diversity'; 'about' signals the Buddhist sits inside the jumble.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrunken and wrinkled with age or drought, like a withered apple.

clue.text: Expressionless churchman ringing a displaced person

indicators.note: ringing means surrounding, like a ring round something

parts.note: a dean is a senior clergyman
DP is the abbreviation for displaced person, a refugee

explanation.surface: A stony-faced cleric rings a refugee.
explanation.definitionFit: A face showing no emotion is blank, a straight face used by comedians.

clue.text: Feature of the tomato that's a native of North America?

explanation.surface: The tomato's colouring is likened to a native American.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is an old, now offensive term for a Native American.
explanation.definitionFit: A tomato has a scarlet outer peel; the second is a dated, now offensive name for an indigenous American.

clue.text: F BI agents in set part

indicators.note: in tells us the agents go inside the other word

parts.note: taken as written
G-men are FBI agents, government men

explanation.surface: Federal agents are placed on a film set.
explanation.definitionFit: A section or piece of a whole, such as an orange's division.

clue.text: One who is legally qualified to spread the Moslem faith

definitions.text: One who is legally qualified to spread the Moslem faith

parts.words: One who is legally qualified to spread the Moslem faith
parts.note: a teacher trained in Islamic law, described as a qualified expounder of Islam

explanation.surface: A trained religious lawyer preaches Islam.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the title of a Muslim cleric learned in theology and sacred law.

clue.text: Broken reed I'd inwardly laugh at

indicators.note: inwardly tells us the next piece goes inside the scrambled letters
broken signals the letters of the word after it are split up and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: Someone mocks a snapped reed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Broken reed' suggests a person who fails you, but 'Broken' is the anagram signal; 'inwardly' signals the insertion.
explanation.definitionFit: To mock or ridicule someone is to scoff at them.

clue.text: Prokofiev has no proof it's on the Dnieper

indicators.note: has no tells us the following word's letters are taken out of the composer's name

explanation.surface: The composer lacks evidence about a Ukrainian river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has no' removes P, R, O, O and F, scattered through PROKOFIEV in order, leaving four letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ukrainian capital stands on the banks of the great river flowing to the Black Sea.

clue.text: Star-shaped figure toppled by revolution

indicators.note: shaped means the letters of the preceding word are formed into a new order

explanation.surface: A star-shaped figure falls over in a turn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shaped' rearranges STAR; the definition refers to Russian emperors overthrown in 1917.
explanation.definitionFit: Russia's emperor, Nicholas II, was overthrown in the 1917 revolution.

clue.text: It puts a shine on finger plates

definitions.text: It puts a shine on finger plates

parts.words: It puts a shine on finger plates
parts.note: finger plates are door fittings, but here they are fingernails being glossed with cosmetic lacquer

explanation.surface: A cleaner buffs the metal plates on doors.
explanation.walkthrough: Finger plates are the metal plates fixed on doors to keep them clean; here the plates are fingernails.
explanation.definitionFit: Cosmetic lacquer is painted on fingernails, the plates at finger ends, to make them glossy.

clue.text: Dry fellows swallowing nothing but small drinks

indicators.note: swallowing means the first piece takes the second inside it

parts.note: TT stands for teetotal, so TTs are abstainers, dry men
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Teetotallers gulp down small measures.
explanation.definitionFit: A tot is a small measure of spirits, a dram.

clue.text: The cream for which herons dive frantically?

indicators.note: frantically signals the letters of the preceding words are wildly rearranged

explanation.surface: Wading birds plunge wildly for a treat.
explanation.walkthrough: Devonshire cream is clotted cream from the English county of Devon.
explanation.definitionFit: Clotted cream from the south-west English county is named after it, a thick cream served with scones.
